title: Urisee Reutte
highlights: Crystal-clear natural mountain lake without surface inflow or outflow at 935 m elevation
Deep alpine lake plunging down to 38 meters offering extraordinary scuba diving
Freely accessible sunbathing lawns equipped with wooden swimming piers and cabins
Pleasant shoreline walking path and traditional tavern located right at the water
kurzbeschreibung: The Urisee near Reutte is a crystal-clear natural lake up to 38 metres deep, offering free swimming access and diving grounds.
beschreibung:
Crystal-Clear Natural Jewel near Reutte

The Urisee is picturesquely situated in a wooded hollow northeast of the market town of Reutte at 935 metres above sea level. As a drainage-free blind lake, it is fed exclusively by subterranean springs, contributing to its extraordinary water purity and emerald green colour.

Diving and Swimming in Pure Nature

With depths of up to 38 metres, the lake is a valued magnet for scuba divers who explore the underwater training course. In summer, locals and visitors alike take advantage of the well-maintained, freely accessible wooden jetties and sunbathing lawns to refresh themselves against the backdrop of the Tannheimer and Lechtaler mountains.
